items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1958-05-26
items.q: That's the check. He's the president, Charles E. Handy.

ctx.x: Give my kindest regards to Mr. Russell Robinson, if he is still with you. With best wishes, we beg to remain very truly yours. Handy Brothers Music Company, Incorporated. P.S. If you have a photograph of the original Dixie Line jazz band, one that I could use for a title cover of St. Louis Blues, would like very, very much for you to rest saying to me so that I could use this for our next issue.
And that's Charles Handy. That's the check. He's the president, Charles E. Handy. That's the check. That's the secretary of treasurer.
And here's a check for $50 from the solvent savings bank and trust company.
